_about: SUBSIDE WERC OPERA DISP-S1 pipeline modeled for the svo-adapter. SUBSIDE runs the whole WERC analysis as ONE monolithic Tapis job (STAGE=run on subside-werc-opera-analysis; see subside/tapis/workflows/pipelines/werc-opera.yaml). The adapter does NOT decompose that job — it submits it as a single step (run-werc), then chains the ETL/load tail (format-convert + publish + stac-publish) to make the output model-ready and discoverable. So a generated pipeline is: [one Tapis job] -> [adapter ETL transforms as the target needs] -> [catalog register]. Registry is in the shape app.hasura.TRANSFORM_REGISTRY_QUERY returns; `catalog` round-trips via transform_contract.metadata_json. The stac-publish piece is shared with H2I; publish is WERC-specific because its contract is geotiff.

transform_specs.name: run-werc
transform_specs.description: The full SUBSIDE WERC analysis as ONE Tapis job (discover + download + stack + reference + velocity + export, all in-process via STAGE=run). The adapter submits this unchanged.

transform_specs.name: format-convert
transform_specs.description: Generic adapter ETL: convert a raster between formats (e.g. GeoTIFF/COG <-> NetCDF) to match a model input. Runs as the pipeline tail, after the job.

transform_specs.name: publish
transform_specs.description: Emit the unified subside-run-manifest.json describing the run's products.

transform_specs.name: stac-publish
transform_specs.description: Dual-write the product to the CKAN FileStore + the STAC API (stacmap.publish, the stac-platform backend) as one discoverable Item. Shared by BOTH SUBSIDE pipelines.

product_pattern.description: Comma-separated filename patterns of the products to publish: the WERC cumulative and velocity GeoTIFFs, or the H2I displacement COG with its overlay. The piece is shared by both pipelines, so one default covers both.

source_data_object.label: OPERA DISP-S1 products (discovered) over Houston AOI, 2024
source_data_object.description: CMR-discovered OPERA L3 DISP-S1 granule references for the AOI + date range, fed into the single WERC job.

target_model_input._about: A subsidence-rate GeoTIFF — exactly what the single WERC job produces. The plan is just [run-werc]: one job, already model-ready, no ETL tail needed.

target_model_input_cataloged._about: Same product, made DISCOVERABLE in CKAN + STAC. The target-side catalog requirement lives in this variant's own `catalog` key. Plan = [run-werc, stac-publish]: one job, then the catalog load on the end.

target_model_input_netcdf._about: A model that needs the rate as a DISCOVERABLE NetCDF. Plan = [run-werc, format-convert, stac-publish]: one job, then the ETL (format-convert) + load (stac-publish) on the end.
